title: Memory-assisted squeezed light velocimetry under realistic loss and incoherent noise
summary: We propose a velocity sensor based on a two-memory Mach--Zehnder interferometer fed by a coherent probe and squeezed vacuum, read out by balanced homodyne detection. One memory is taken as a stationary reference, while the second memory moves during storage, so that its velocity is mapped onto a differential interferometric phase at readout. The two memories are otherwise assumed identical and are described by a Gaussian write--store--read lifetime together with the associated unconditional noise floor.
